notification.title: Chess training time!
notification.intro: Your session is ready: {{taskCount}} tasks, about {{minutes}} min.

page.title: Today's session
page.subtitle: Prepared for you based on your level and progress

why.title: Why these tasks?
why.body: The session is built from your puzzle rating, weakest tactical themes, due lesson reviews and recent activity. It adapts after every session.

completed.title: Session completed — well done!
completed.body: Every task is finished. The next session will take your progress into account.

partiallyDone.title: Session is over
partiallyDone.body: You completed {{done}} of {{total}} tasks. Unfinished reviews and themes move to the next session.

expired.title: Session expired
expired.body: This session wasn't started in time. Don't worry — the next one will pick up where you left off.

empty.noSchedule: You don't have a training schedule yet. Choose convenient days and time — the platform will prepare each session for you.
empty.noSession: No session is planned yet. The next one will appear closer to your scheduled time.
